<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="B9tJBojHzoz5nyYXiA70" name="Page-1"> <mxGraphModel dx="2076" dy="1091" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 participant Parent as Parent: host root
 participant Child as Child: new namespaces
 participant Shell as Inspection shell

 Parent->>Parent: Unshare mount namespace and make mounts private
 Parent->>Parent: MountOverlay, configure upper ownership
 Parent->>Parent: Bind merged, then ParentMountAll(merged)
 Parent->>Child: Start child with merged path and UID/GID mappings
 Note over Parent,Child: Child inherits the staged mount tree
 Parent->>Parent: Add child to cgroup, wait for child

 Child->>Child: Set hostname and make mounts private
 Child->>Child: Mount procfs, then PivotRoot(merged)
 Child->>Shell: Start /bin/sh with inspectScript
 Shell->>Shell: Read Alpine and write /marker.txt through /
 Shell-->>Child: Shell exits
 Child-->>Parent: Child exits, cmd.Wait returns

 Parent->>Parent: Normal return: UnmountOverlay, then cgroup.Cleanup
 Note over Parent: Upper files remain on disk",
 "config": null
